correctness.rationale: For n=pm with p=P(n)>y and p||n, positivity of sigma*(m) makes p(c sigma^(e)(m)-sigma*(m))=sigma*(m) uniquely solvable at most once for each m. Integers lacking such p are y-smooth or divisible by a square p² with p>y, giving N_c(X)<=Psi(X,y)+O(X/y) independently of c. Rankin Euler-product bound at y=exp(sqrt(L log L)/sqrt2), u=L/log y and delta=(log u-2loglog u)/log y implies log Psi <=L-(1/sqrt2+o(1))sqrt(L log L); the prime square and higher Euler contributions are summable, and Mertens sum reciprocal primes handles the first-order term. The o(1) is uniform in c. Independent exact arithmetic tested divisor ratios up to 10000 and 9597 recoverable primes; not an asymptotic proof.
residual_risks: Asymptotic X→∞, uniform positive real c; no finiteness/infinitude decision for any fiber.
Finite arithmetic checks are corroborative only.
